class.name: DisDatumPdu
class.brief_description: Base class of the Simulation Management PDUs that carry datum records: Comment, Set Data and Data.
class.description: DisDatumPdu holds the datum lists shared by [DisCommentPdu], [DisSetDataPdu] and [DisDataPdu]. A [i]fixed datum[/i] is a [Dictionary] [code]{"id": int, "value": int}[/code]: a 32-bit datum ID and 32 raw bits of value. A [i]variable datum[/i] is a [Dictionary] [code]{"id": int, "length": int, "data": PackedByteArray}[/code]: a 32-bit ID, the length in [i]bits[/i], and [code]ceil(length / 8)[/code] bytes of data; on the wire the data is padded with zeros to a multiple of 8 bytes. Datum IDs are SISO-REF-010 "Variable Record Types" or agreed within the exercise. Use [method add_fixed_datum], [method add_variable_datum] and [method add_text] to fill the lists, and [method get_text] to read text back. [codeblock] var comment := DisCommentPdu.new() comment.originating_id = Vector3i(1, 1, 0) comment.receiving_id = Vector3i(DisSimulationManagementPdu.ID_ALL, DisSimulationManagementPdu.ID_ALL, DisSimulationManagementPdu.ID_ALL) comment.add_text(1, "Phase line ALPHA crossed") var bytes := comment.encode() [/codeblock] These PDUs are encoded with godot-dis's own code rather than open-dis-cpp, which rounds variable datum bit lengths down to whole bytes. A datum list that does not fit in the PDU makes the decoder return [code]null[/code].

method.name: add_fixed_datum
method.description: Appends a fixed datum with the 32-bit datum [param id] and 32 raw bits of [param value] to [member fixed_datums].

method.name: add_text
method.description: Appends a variable datum with the given [param id] holding [param text] as UTF-8 to [member variable_datums]. Its length is the number of bits in the UTF-8 bytes.

method.name: add_variable_datum
method.description: Appends a variable datum with the given [param id] and [param data] to [member variable_datums]. [param length_bits] is the length of the data in bits; if it is negative (the default), the whole of [param data] is used. When encoding, [param data] must hold at least [code]ceil(length_bits / 8)[/code] bytes; a datum with less is skipped and an error is printed.

method.name: get_text
method.description: Returns the data of the first variable datum whose ID is [param id], decoded as UTF-8 text. Returns an empty string if there is no such datum.

members.member: Fixed datum records as an [Array] of [Dictionary] [code]{"id": int, "value": int}[/code] (32-bit ID, 32 raw bits of value). See [method add_fixed_datum].
The 32-bit padding field that follows the request ID in Set Data and Data PDUs. Normally 0; kept so that decoded PDUs encode to the same bytes. Not used by [DisCommentPdu], which has no such field.

Variable datum records as an [Array] of [Dictionary] [code]{"id": int, "length": int, "data": PackedByteArray}[/code], where [code]length[/code] is in bits. See [method add_variable_datum] and [method add_text].
